{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Appetizers|Appetizers]]

This is a good snack to serve as an appetizer. You may use a lot of variations on this recipe.

== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]] or [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Seasoned Salt|seasoned salt]], [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic salt]], or [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian seasoning]]
*2+ handfuls of pretzels

== Equipment ==
*Deep [[Cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]]
*[[Cookbook:spatula|Spatula]]
*Plate
*[[Cookbook:Paper Towel|Paper towels]]

==Procedure==

# Fill a deep [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] partially full of canola oil. Heat up the oil.
# Cover a paper towel with seasoning (the paper towel will help absorb moisture). Then set paper towel on a plate.
# Use a spatula to drop pretzels into oil. Only leave them in for 2–3 seconds.
# Remove pretzels, and lay them out on bed of seasoning to dry. The oil may be used for multiple batches.
